svg.title: Odradek R4 electrical architecture and internal harness screening
svg.desc: Original engineering diagram showing seven EtherCAT joints, detachable four-finger head, two separate GMSL video channels, external compute and power. Stop and brake integration remains unconfirmed. Not released for manufacture.
svg.text: 电气拓扑与内走线约束
12 EtherCAT slaves = 7 arm + 4 finger + 1 head I/O · 2 cameras · external compute
尚未冻结 · NOT FOR MANUFACTURE
实时运动主机 / RT host
视觉主机 + 解串采集
独占运动 NIC；上层网络单独连接
48 V · protection / regen / cable gauge TBD | phase current ≠ bus current
RH 的认证 STO / SBC 尚未证实；J7 无闸，J7 与四指保持方案待验证。
Stop / brake interface is a requirement, not an established safe circuit.
24 V FINGER MOTOR · separate source / current / regen protection TBD
24 V AUX → head I/O / LED logic; RH separate logic supply is not confirmed
视觉主机电源按载板规范；AC / PE 未画
24 V指动力与辅助电分开；电流/回馈待验证，急停不等于切断全部辅助电。
Camera power comes from capture-board PoC. No 24 V injection into coax.
GMSL2 + PoC · connector / channel validation pending
上下外倾；遮挡与近场视域待标定
线束占积初筛 / AREA SCREEN ONLY
示例全束 113.44 mm²；含两组24 V支路，绝缘外径仍是假设。
Ø10 mm 中仅放 2 × Ø3.1 mm 同轴：毛面积填充约 19.2%。
面积通过 ≠ 可装配 / 可转动；衬套、接头、弯曲半径与寿命另验。
40% 仅为项目筛查假设；不是法规、制造公差或合格标准。
实际动作时序和安全等级未冻结，不能按图直接接线。
突然掉电：上述受控步骤可能不可用；必须独立验证防坠与工件保持。
Loss of power needs a separate holding / fallback design.
保持制动器不等于动态制动器；安全继电器不等于完整安全系统。
3D 打印首版只做几何与手动动作，不具备已验证的 2 kg 承载能力。
Project-original vector diagram · sources and assumptions: hardware/electrical-camera-candidates.md, harness-and-connectors.md
No measured harness life, electrical safety performance or payload qualification is claimed.
